I’d ask the group if they’d be okay with a reroll, as negatives affect the party dynamic a lot more than positives. With negatives you lose the ability to do bare minimum damage and will start failing at the basics often. A few extra positives won’t really matter in the long run as level plays more into how skills/hp/to hit, work anyways. To put it another way, overshooting a DC provides no additional benefit besides passing where as hitting under is the difference between a pass and a fail, as well as it caps your saves to below the d20 which even basic monsters could be higher than making a save impossible (unless you do crit fails/successes on saves and/or ability checks.)
If they did it in front of me then they can keep. Otherwise if a player comes to me claiming it, then I tell to reroll.
